user.title: Shelly Pro 3EM Bridge
user.description: Configure the MQTT source and the virtual Shelly device identity.

data_description.device_mac: Must be unique on your LAN, e.g. 5C:CF:7F:AA:BB:01. Changing this after setup requires re-adding the bridge in the Shelly App.
data_description.mqtt_topic: The MQTT topic that publishes the current power consumption as a plain numeric value in Watts.
data_description.http_port: Port for the virtual Shelly HTTP/WebSocket server. Must be ≥1024 and not used by another process.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.port_in_use: Port is already in use. Choose a different port.

abort.already_configured: A bridge with this MAC address is already configured.
